verdict.rationale: Skyvern publishes a dedicated versioning-and-deprecation page. It commits to at least 6 months notice before an endpoint is sunset and at least 12 months before a major version is removed, and it promises RFC 9745/8594 Deprecation/Sunset headers plus `deprecated: true` markers in the OpenAPI spec. The API is versioned (/v1/ paths, an OpenAPI 3.1 document at api.skyvern.com, and a reference generated from it). The probe's 404s at skyvern.com/openapi.json do not contradict this, because the spec is served from the api subdomain. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation policy and headers are honored in practice.
